description: NFC boundary PASS: jcs-n preserves decomposed code points as-is and applies RFC 8785 §3.2.3 code-unit-by-code-unit ordering (no length-first rule). Key U+0041 U+030A (A + combining ring above) has first code unit U+0041, which is LESS THAN U+0042 (B), so the decomposed key sorts FIRST. Motivated by Joel Hillier on-list finding (2026-07-27): no published corpus exercises this boundary.
note: RFC 8785 §3.2.3 compares UTF-16 code units left-to-right (lexicographic, no length-first rule). U+0041 < U+0042, so the decomposed key (U+0041 U+030A) sorts before B. UTF-8 encoding of U+030A is 0xCC 0x8A, giving pre_image_bytes_hex 7b2241cc8a... (decomposed key first). See jcs-n-nfc-contrast-01: NFC normalization changes BOTH member order AND bytes.
